assessment.nobel_worthiness: Squeezing made quantum noise a controllable resource and transformed precision optical measurement.
assessment.attribution: The listed theory, experimental quantum-optics, and sustained metrology contributions form a coherent three-person citation.
assessment.maturity: The effect and its metrological value have been independently established and deployed for decades.
uncertainties: The precise boundary between foundational squeezing work and later gravitational-wave applications needs careful citation design.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Circuit QED created a remarkably clean, controllable setting for quantum optics and has reshaped experimental quantum physics.
assessment.attribution: These names capture seminal theoretical formulation and decisive experimental realization of superconducting artificial atoms coupled to microwave fields.
assessment.maturity: Its essential phenomena have been reproduced broadly and underpin a major experimental platform.
uncertainties: The field overlaps substantially with superconducting-circuit advances already recognized, requiring a sharply distinct formulation of the discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Their proposals gave quantum information a concrete physical route to computation and simulation with controllable atomic systems.
assessment.attribution: The pair is an unusually clear and compact attribution for foundational architectures and protocols.
assessment.maturity: Ion and neutral-atom platforms have tested and extended these ideas over many years.
uncertainties: The contribution is broad and theoretical, so the prize wording must distinguish it from later platform-specific achievements.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks unite exquisite control of atoms with a major advance in time and frequency measurement.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye are strongly associated with the invention and realization of the clock concept.
assessment.maturity: Performance and reproducibility across laboratories are exceptional, with broad scientific consequences.
uncertainties: Independent assessment is needed of how completely the two names cover the enabling clock developments.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Topological insulators revealed a new robust phase of matter with protected boundary transport.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele provide the central prediction, while Molenkamp represents landmark experimental confirmation.
assessment.maturity: The conceptual framework and characteristic transport have been extensively tested.
uncertainties: A final attribution review must resolve the relation to quantum anomalous Hall work and other experimental contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Car–Parrinello method made predictive first-principles simulation of complex atomic motion broadly practical.
assessment.attribution: The two originators are cleanly identified by the named method.
assessment.maturity: Its influence is longstanding and pervasive in condensed-matter and materials research.
uncertainties: It is necessary to weigh a computational-method prize against discoveries of physical phenomena.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: SASE X-ray free-electron lasers opened coherent ultrafast X-ray science at previously inaccessible brightness.
assessment.attribution: The listed theorists and experimental advocate plausibly cover the central conception and realization.
assessment.maturity: Working facilities and a large body of science demonstrate robust technological and scientific maturity.
uncertainties: The distributed development of accelerator concepts makes individual attribution particularly demanding.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and interference phases exposed profound, observable aspects of quantum mechanics and continue to organize modern physics.
assessment.attribution: Berry and Aharonov are central names for the complementary phase phenomena in the citation.
assessment.maturity: The effects are experimentally established and conceptually influential across many quantum systems.
uncertainties: The historical and conceptual distinction between the Aharonov–Bohm and Berry effects may favor separate rather than joint recognition.
